$Comment: The essence quest: Life essence is the table's ordinary wage, drawn out of every piece, and
this quest asks for it in numbers.
draw_essence counts essence the tables hand over (STATION_OUTPUT, exact id, qualified to
'Disenchanting_Table' on PREFIX so both tiers count and the Sawmill, which also pays Life
essence, does not); deliver_essence is Order 2, an exact-id hand-in to Orrin. Requires carries
an Enchanting level gate beside the stations feature, one step on the chain's own level curve:
it sits below the level the Steady Hands rung asks for, so the two read as a climb rather than
a wall. Keep it under that figure if you retune either. Rewards: a personal Enchanting boost
token (the Mmo_Boost_Token kind: Skill, Multiplier, DurationMinutes) and XP.
Name: The_Essence_Draw
